title: NEMAR Zarr producer manifest (format_version 1)
description: Producer-side sidecar at <data_base>manifest.json, holding the git-annex source key each store was built from. This lived in index.json until format v3: on nm000281 the per-store source_key was 2.3 MB of a 12.8 MB index (18 percent) that no consumer read, and index.json is fetched by every dataset-page visit. Split out rather than deleted because the producer still needs it to answer 'which blob is this store made of'. Nothing on nemar.org reads this file; it carries no serving contract and may change shape more freely than the index.

files.description: Dataset-level objects this run published beside index.json, with the size it wrote. Producer bookkeeping, like the rest of this document: it is how a later run (or an operator) can tell that the events file on S3 is the one this conversion wrote without downloading it. Absent or empty when the run published none.

name.description: Object name relative to the dataset's zarr prefix. Enumerated rather than free-form: index.json and manifest.json describe themselves, so the only member today is the events file (#1060).

row_count.description: Rows in the file, matching the index's events_row_count. One row per (event, channel group), not per event.

zarr.description: Store path relative to the dataset's zarr prefix -- the join key back to the index's stores[].

source_key.description: The git-annex key of the recording's primary file (e.g. SHA256E-s123--...), or null when the recording is not annexed or the key could not be read.

size_bytes.description: Source size in bytes as declared by the annex key itself, or null when the key carries no size.

$comment: STABILITY POLICY. Closed at format_version 1 (additionalProperties:false throughout), and PRODUCER-INTERNAL: nothing on nemar.org reads this file, so it carries no serving contract and may change shape more freely than the index. Additive change ships as format_version 1 with new optional fields; a breaking change is format_version 2 at /schemas/zarr-manifest-v2.json.
